# 大乘緣生論

**Category:** 論集部類
**Original Category:** 論集部
**Byline:** 欝楞迦造  唐 不空譯
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 746–774
**Juans:** 1

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-*juǎn* verse-and-prose treatise on dependent origination (*pratītyasamutpāda*), translated into Chinese by [不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA) (Amoghavajra, 705–774) at the Táng court probably in the Tiānbǎo or Dàlì period. The Sanskrit original is the same work as that translated a century earlier by [達磨笈多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%94%E7%A3%A8%E7%AC%88%E5%A4%9A) (Dharmagupta) as the *[Yuánshēng lùn 緣生論](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0056)*; the Taishō editorial apparatus correctly notes "No. 1653 [No. 1652]". Amoghavajra's title adds the qualifier *Dàshèng* 大乘 ("Mahāyāna") to distinguish his version and to mark it as belonging to the Mahāyāna *abhidharma* corpus.

**Abstract**

The Taishō text opens "大乘緣生論一卷（聖者欝楞迦造） / 開府儀同三司特進試鴻臚卿肅國公食邑三千戶賜紫贈司空諡大鑒正號大廣智大興善寺三藏沙門不空奉　詔譯" — the standard Tang imperial-titles preamble of Amoghavajra's late translations, conferred during the Dàlì 大曆 reign. The translation is post-746 (Amoghavajra's return from the south) and pre-774 (his death). Comparison with *[Dharmagupta's Yuánshēng lùn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0056)* shows the two are translations of the same Indic original; Amoghavajra's version is more polished and typically of his late-Tang idiom — a characteristic feature of the *jīnyì* 今譯 ("new translation") movement of the Esoteric school. The translation is registered in the *Zhēnyuán xīndìng shìjiào mùlù* 貞元新定釋教目錄 (T2157) of Yuánzhào 圓照 (799–800), which identifies it as a re-translation of Dharmagupta's Suí version.
